payload.description:
## Context
When agent files, always-on fragments and skills are read by current models, I want their text to follow the Fable 5.2 prompt guidance, so I can get the intended behaviour without stale or conflicting instructions.
18 accepted findings, one lane, one landing, three commits: agents F01, F10, F12; always-on text W01, W02, W03, W04, W07 (owner decisions of 2026-11-13); skills D01, D02, S01 to S08. The findings with their source spans are in the orchestrator's local files codex-findings-agents.md, codex-findings-fragments.md and codex-findings-skills.md (not in git). Decided by the orchestrator 2026-11-13. Builder: codex-1, which claims it.
payload.title: Text cut 1: bring agent, always-on and skill text in line with the Fable 5.2 guidance
